---
title: "Sensitivity analysis - one factor at a time over five Phase 2 constants"
output: html_document
params:
  scenario_pipeline: "Phase2RunSimulation.Rmd"   # the Phase 2 notebook to render
  baseline_config:   "baseline__no_pri_no_av"      # Vision Zero denominator
  treatment_config:  "grid_local__pri_av"          # the policy scenario of interest
  tod:               "AM"                           # single time of day for the whole study
  sens_root:  "./outputs/sensitivity"   # one subfolder of Phase 2 CSVs per render point
  cache_dir:  "./cache"                 # shared across renders (reuses skims and networks)
  force_rerun:  false                   # TRUE = re-render even if a point's CSVs exist
  java_heap_gb: 20
  vz_baseline_fatalities: 29.4
  vz_hughes_elasticity:   1.0
  vz_nilsson_exp_fatal:   3.0
---

One-factor-at-a-time (OFAT) sensitivity around the published Phase 2 constants,
for one time of day and two configurations: the baseline (existing network,
current streets; also the Vision Zero denominator) and the treatment (Grid +
Local, transit priority, AV-induced traffic).

Three constants act through the road equilibrium, so each value is a fresh
render of `Phase2RunSimulation.Rmd` restricted to the two configurations:
`av_drive_tt_shrink`, `bpr_vc_cap`, `auto_occupancy`. The two Vision Zero
exponents (`vz_nilsson_exp_fatal`, `vz_hughes_elasticity`) are pure arithmetic on
the base render's VMT and speed ratios, so they need no renders.

Outputs (read by `ThesisTables.Rmd` and `ThesisFigures.Rmd`):

* `outputs/sensitivity/sensitivity_metrics.csv` - one row per (render point,
  configuration): mode shares, speed, VMT, 30-minute job accessibility, and the
  treatment's projected fatalities.
* `outputs/sensitivity/vz_exponent_sweep.csv` - projected treatment fatalities
  over the exponent grid.

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(readr); library(purrr)
})
SENS_ROOT <- normalizePath(params$sens_root, mustWork = FALSE)
dir.create(SENS_ROOT, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
CONFIGS   <- c(params$baseline_config, params$treatment_config)
fs_path   <- function(p) gsub("\\\\", "/", p)
```

# The OFAT grid

```{r grid}
base_vals <- list(av_drive_tt_shrink = 0.41, bpr_vc_cap = 2.0, auto_occupancy = 1.10)
sweeps <- list(
  av_drive_tt_shrink = c(0.25, 0.41, 0.60, 0.80),
  bpr_vc_cap         = c(1.5, 2.0, 3.0),
  auto_occupancy     = c(1.00, 1.10, 1.25))
v_tag <- function(v) gsub("\\.", "p", formatC(v, format = "f", drop0trailing = TRUE))

plan <- imap_dfr(sweeps, function(vals, pname) tibble(param_name = pname, param_value = vals)) |>
  mutate(is_base = map2_lgl(param_name, param_value, ~ isTRUE(all.equal(.y, base_vals[[.x]]))),
         tag = if_else(is_base, "base",
                       sprintf("%s_%s", param_name, vapply(param_value, v_tag, ""))))
# The base point is shared by all three sweeps, so it is rendered once.
render_points <- plan |> distinct(tag, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  mutate(param_name = if_else(is_base, "(base)", param_name))
render_points
```

# Renders

Each render is a fresh R process (clean r5r Java VM) with all three constants
pinned explicitly; an off-base point overrides just one of them.

```{r renders}
rscript <- file.path(R.home("bin"), if (.Platform$OS.type == "windows") "Rscript.exe" else "Rscript")
needed_csvs <- c("mode_share_by_config_tod.csv", "vmt_speed_by_config_tod.csv",
                 "employment_accessibility_by_tract_mode_tod.csv")

for (i in seq_len(nrow(render_points))) {
  rp <- render_points[i, ]
  out_dir <- file.path(SENS_ROOT, rp$tag)
  if (!params$force_rerun && all(file.exists(file.path(out_dir, needed_csvs)))) next
  dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  ov <- base_vals
  if (!rp$is_base) ov[[rp$param_name]] <- rp$param_value
  plist <- c(list(cache_dir = fs_path(normalizePath(params$cache_dir)),
                  output_dir = fs_path(normalizePath(out_dir)),
                  tods_to_run = params$tod, configs_filter = CONFIGS,
                  java_heap_gb = as.integer(params$java_heap_gb)), ov)
  driver <- tempfile(fileext = ".R")
  writeLines(c(
    "options(warn = 1)",
    sprintf("rmarkdown::render(%s, output_format = 'html_document', run_pandoc = FALSE,",
            deparse(params$scenario_pipeline)),
    sprintf("  quiet = TRUE, envir = new.env(), params = %s)",
            paste(deparse(plist), collapse = " "))), driver)
  message(sprintf("render %s (%s = %s)", rp$tag, rp$param_name, rp$param_value))
  status <- system2(rscript, shQuote(driver))
  if (!identical(status, 0L) || !all(file.exists(file.path(out_dir, needed_csvs))))
    stop("Sensitivity render failed: ", rp$tag)
}
```

# Collect metrics

Accessibility is the tract mean of jobs reachable within 30 minutes. The
treatment's fatalities at each point are projected against the baseline at the
same constant value: `29.4 x (VMT ratio)^Hughes x (speed ratio)^Nilsson`.

```{r collect}
read_point <- function(tag) {
  d  <- file.path(SENS_ROOT, tag)
  ms <- read_csv(file.path(d, needed_csvs[1]), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
    filter(tod == params$tod, config_id %in% CONFIGS) |>
    select(config_id, drive, transit, walk, bike)
  vs <- read_csv(file.path(d, needed_csvs[2]), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
    filter(tod == params$tod, config_id %in% CONFIGS) |>
    select(config_id, avg_speed_mph, vmt_peakhr, pct_vmt_on_overcap)
  ac <- read_csv(file.path(d, needed_csvs[3]), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
    filter(tod == params$tod, config_id %in% CONFIGS, mode %in% c("drive", "transit")) |>
    group_by(config_id, mode) |>
    summarise(jobs_30min = mean(jobs_30min, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = mode, values_from = jobs_30min, names_prefix = "jobs_30min_")
  ms |> left_join(vs, by = "config_id") |> left_join(ac, by = "config_id") |>
    mutate(tag = tag, .before = 1)
}

metrics <- map_dfr(render_points$tag, read_point) |>
  left_join(render_points |> select(tag, param_name, param_value, is_base), by = "tag") |>
  mutate(role = if_else(config_id == params$baseline_config, "baseline", "treatment"))

ratios <- metrics |>
  select(tag, role, vmt_peakhr, avg_speed_mph) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = role, values_from = c(vmt_peakhr, avg_speed_mph)) |>
  transmute(tag,
            vmt_ratio   = vmt_peakhr_treatment / vmt_peakhr_baseline,
            speed_ratio = avg_speed_mph_treatment / avg_speed_mph_baseline)

metrics <- metrics |>
  left_join(ratios, by = "tag") |>
  mutate(fatalities = if_else(role == "baseline", params$vz_baseline_fatalities,
                              params$vz_baseline_fatalities *
                                vmt_ratio^params$vz_hughes_elasticity *
                                speed_ratio^params$vz_nilsson_exp_fatal))
write_csv(metrics, file.path(SENS_ROOT, "sensitivity_metrics.csv"))
metrics |> select(tag, role, drive, transit, avg_speed_mph, fatalities)
```

# Vision Zero exponent sweep (no renders)

```{r vz-sweep}
base_r <- ratios |> filter(tag == "base")
vz_sweep <- crossing(nilsson = c(2.0, 3.0, 4.0, 4.5), hughes = c(0.5, 1.0, 1.2)) |>
  mutate(vmt_ratio = base_r$vmt_ratio, speed_ratio = base_r$speed_ratio,
         fatalities = params$vz_baseline_fatalities * vmt_ratio^hughes * speed_ratio^nilsson,
         pct_vs_baseline = 100 * (fatalities / params$vz_baseline_fatalities - 1),
         is_base = nilsson == params$vz_nilsson_exp_fatal & hughes == params$vz_hughes_elasticity)
write_csv(vz_sweep, file.path(SENS_ROOT, "vz_exponent_sweep.csv"))
vz_sweep
```
